proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures in Image Generation Pipelines via GitHub Actions
proposals.current_pain_description: When image APIs (Pollinations, Together, Runware) return 429, 500, or empty responses, workflows continue and generate corrupted/blank PDFs or packages, wasting GitHub Actions execution time and causing silent failures that Hugo only discovers after manual inspection on his phone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a centralized Python helper `image_validator.py` that verifies: 1) HTTP status code, 2) magic bytes/mime-type of the downloaded payload, 3) minimum file size (e.g., >20KB), and 4) executes automatic retries with exponential backoff before failing the GHA step explicitly.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates empty/corrupt outputs, saves manual mobile verification time, and optimizes GHA compute cycles.

proposals.issue_title: Termux Copy-Paste Bottleneck for Mobile Uploads
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates 100% from an Android phone. Extracting generated titles, tags, descriptions, and file URLs from raw GitHub run logs or complex JSON files to paste them into KDP/Redbubble forms on a mobile browser is highly tedious and error-prone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a GHA step that compiles all metadata into a single, clean HTML dashboard index.html deployed to a private/password-protected GitHub Pages site. The site will feature 'Click-to-Copy' buttons for titles, tags, and description fields, plus direct download links for the assets, optimized for mobile screens.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual listing time on mobile by 50%, maximizing the ROI of Hugo's 10 hours/week limit.

proposals.current_pain_description: If a GHA workflow gets stuck in an infinite loop or parallel cron runs trigger simultaneously, the €20 Runware credit can be entirely consumed in a single night without Hugo's knowledge.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a lightweight budget tracking file (`.runware_spend.json`) committed back to the repository (or stored in GHA Cache). Every API call logs its cost. The wrapper script must instantly block further API requests if the daily spend exceeds €1.00 or monthly spend exceeds €18.00.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Absolute protection against unexpected financial losses on Hugo's strict €20/month budget.

proposals.issue_title: Missing Cross-Pollination of Coloring Book Vectors to Digital SVG Packs
proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality line art created for coloring books (KDP) is currently only packaged as PDF pages. This represents a lost opportunity to sell the same assets as SVG/PNG design cuts for Cricut/Silhouette users on Etsy/Cults3D.
proposals.proposed_fix: Modify the coloring book post-processing step. When vector-like line art is successfully generated, automatically output a parallel ZIP file of individual high-resolution PNGs (with transparent backgrounds) and SVGs, labeled and tagged for digital craft marketplaces.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Doubles the product output per hour worked by generating two distinct product types (KDP paperback + digital SVG pack) from a single generation run.

proposals.issue_title: Brittle API Client Implementations and Hardcoded Models
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines rely on hardcoded model strings (like deprecated Gemini experimental models) and disparate API client implementations, making the codebase fragile when providers update their APIs or deprecate models.
proposals.proposed_fix: Consolidate all LLM and image calls into a unified, lightweight wrapper class `client_factory.py`. This class will read provider priority from a configuration file and dynamically fallback (e.g., if Together AI fails, try Cloudflare Workers AI, then fallback to Pollinations).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees pipeline resilience against API outages, deprecations, and credentials expiration without editing dozens of pipeline scripts.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Quality Auditing for AI-Generated SVG Geometries
proposals.current_pain_description: AI-generated SVGs often contain unclosed paths, overlapping invisible elements, or excessive nodes that crash cutting machines or 3D rendering engines, leading to potential bad customer reviews on Etsy/Cults3D.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight Python-based SVG sanitizer (using `scour` or `lxml`) in the GHA workflow to automatically clean up unnecessary metadata, merge paths, check for minimum dimensions, and discard files with distorted aspect ratios.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures commercial grade quality of digital assets and prevents store bans due to defective files.
